project_name: Aetheria Credit OS - Gaming Technology & Credit Platform

brand_identity.tagline: Next-Gen Institutional Gaming Credit Infrastructure & Financial Settlement
brand_identity.emotional_archetype: ARCHETYPE 5: LUXURY & HIGH-TECH POWER (Obsidian & Electric Violet)
brand_identity.vibe: High-density institutional fintech meets dark cyber luxury. Precision financial telemetry with glowing violet neon accents.

marketing_landing_page.hero_section: Cinematic dark background with floating purple card graphics, live credit multiplier calculator, target market badges (Cyprus / South Asia / Middle East).
marketing_landing_page.credit_packages_showcase: 5X promotional credit packages with explicit 20% tech service fee breakdown cards.
marketing_landing_page.trust_badges_and_providers: Licensed Cyprus entity status, SSL 256-bit encryption badges, provider logo cloud (Evolution, Pragmatic, Spribe, Playtech).
marketing_landing_page.architecture_diagram: Flow diagram showing User -> Deposit (INR/AED/USDT) -> 20% Tech Fee -> Real Money Wallet + 5X Promotional Credit Allocation.

user_dashboard.dual_wallet_banner: Side-by-side high contrast balance cards: Real Money Wallet (Emerald border, 100% withdrawal eligible) vs Promotional Credit Wallet (Violet glow, 5X multiplier balance).
user_dashboard.package_purchase_flow: Interactive package selector with dynamic calculations (e.g. Deposit ₹20,000 -> Get ₹100,000 Promo Credits, ₹4,000 Tech Fee deduction breakdown).
user_dashboard.mock_deposit_gateway: Interactive modal supporting UPI/NetBanking, Credit Card, AED Wire, and USDT (TRC-20/ERC-20) with instant simulation.
user_dashboard.transaction_history_table: Searchable, filterable ledger with Status pill badges (Completed, Pending, Under Review).
user_dashboard.account_statement_export: Downloadable/printable statement preview with Cyprus regulatory reference.
user_dashboard.support_system: Ticket submission drawer and real-time live support mock chat.

admin_dashboard.cockpit_overview: Real-time key metrics (Total Deposits, Total Promo Issued, Accumulated Tech Fees @ 20%, Pending Approvals, Active Users).
admin_dashboard.deposit_approval_queue: Actionable queue with Approve/Reject triggers and fraud score indicators.
admin_dashboard.user_management_grid: User profile inspector, wallet balance adjustment override, KYB/KYC verification state.
admin_dashboard.fee_configurator: Interactive sliders for adjusting base tech service fees and tier multipliers.
admin_dashboard.fraud_alerts_feed: High-priority alert list highlighting unusual 5X allocation velocity or multiple IP logins.
admin_dashboard.financial_reports: Recharts visual telemetry comparing Real Money Deposits vs Promotional Allocations over time.

testing_and_accessibility.mandatory_rule: Every button, tab, input, table row, card, and modal action MUST have a data-testid attribute formatted in kebab-case.

instructions_to_main_agent: Ensure the entire app operates seamlessly in Luxury Dark mode with smooth state persistence.
Implement clear role/view switcher at the top navigation bar so reviewers can instantly jump between 'Marketing Landing Page', 'User Dashboard', and 'Admin Dashboard'.
Make sure the 5X credit multiplier logic (e.g. ₹20,000 deposit yields ₹100,000 promotional credits with a 20% tech service fee breakdown) is visually prominent and interactive.
All forms and interactive modals (Deposit Gateway, Support Ticket, Config Sliders) should feature interactive state updates and Sonner toast feedback.
Include high-density data visualizations using Recharts in the Admin Dashboard for financial reporting.
Do NOT use transparent headers; use glassmorphism with backdrop blur and border dividers.
